appearance_section.imageFormats: JPEG · PNG · WebP · GIF · AVIF — max 10 MB
appearance_section.autoThemeDesc: Switches theme automatically based on sun.sun (sunrise/sunset).
appearance_section.effectEdgeHint_fade: The bubble fades out near the edge and fades back in on the other side.
appearance_section.effectEdgeHint_bounce: The bubble reverses its path, endlessly.
appearance_section.effectEdgeHint_wrap: The bubble reappears instantly on the other side — the jump is visible.
appearance_section.autoThemeSensorDesc: The sun ignores an overcast sky, closed shutters or a windowless room. A sensor reflects the light actually present.
appearance_section.autoThemeThresholdDesc: Above this value, the day theme applies.
appearance_section.haThemeDesc: Reuse a theme defined in your themes.yaml, so the dashboard matches the rest of your setup.
appearance_section.haThemeEmpty: No custom theme defined in Home Assistant.
appearance_section.haThemeError: Could not fetch themes from Home Assistant.

performance_section.fpsDescription: Measures browser rendering FPS in real time to diagnose slowdowns.
performance_section.intro: Disable costly visual effects to improve performance on tablets and small devices.
performance_section.reduceBlurDesc: Reduces backdrop-filter from 20–40px to 4px on all cards.
performance_section.disableModalAnimationDesc: Replaces the card-opening animation with a simple fade.

sound_section.intro: Play a short sound effect when you interact with widgets (toggle, buttons, sliders…).
sound_section.enabledDesc: Plays a tone when you tap a card or change a setting.

system_section.ingressDesc: Use this URL to open the dashboard without the Home Assistant sidebar (wall display, WallPanel, kiosk mode).
system_section.ingressNotAvailable: Only available when running as a Home Assistant add-on.
system_section.configExportDesc: Generate a text string containing your entire configuration (theme, layout, widgets). Save it or share it to restore later.
system_section.configImportDesc: Paste a previously exported config string to restore all settings.
system_section.configImportConfirm: This will overwrite your current configuration. Click Import again to confirm.
system_section.configImportErrPrefix: Invalid string — must start with HADASH1:
system_section.configImportErrJson: Invalid string — could not parse content.
system_section.configImportErrMissing: Incomplete config — theme or dashboard data is missing.
system_section.historyDesc: The last 20 saved states of your dashboard. Restore one if an import or a change went wrong.
system_section.historyEmpty: Nothing archived yet — history fills up as you make changes.

language_section.overridesDescription: Override specific translation keys with your own text.

layout_section.rowHeightDesc: Height of each grid row (in px).
layout_section.kioskDesc: Hides the Home Assistant header and sidebar. Applies to this device only.

regional_section.intro: These settings apply to this device only. A wall tablet can have its own without your phone inheriting them.
regional_section.returnHomeDesc: After this idle delay, the dashboard returns to the first page and closes anything open.
regional_section.dndDesc: Hides transient notifications on this device. Those awaiting an action stay visible.
regional_section.pinDesc: Ask for a 4-digit code before entering edit mode. Leave empty to disable.
regional_section.pinWarning: A guard against accidental edits, not a security measure: the code is readable from the browser.
regional_section.broadcastDesc: Copies this device's settings (theme, performance, formats, behaviour) to every other screen in the home.
regional_section.broadcastConfirm: This will overwrite the settings of every other device. It cannot be undone.
